reason: I already ask ChatGPT about my portfolio and then place the trades myself, and I'm not handing my real retirement money to an AI shaped like a Tamagotchi when the broker isn't even named yet. A waitlist for a plan with no price and no broker is just demo money with extra steps.
objection: Who actually holds my money, and what happens when the agent makes a dumb trade inside my limits? A cute pet and a downloadable log don't tell me who's liable.
would_change_my_mind: A named, SIPC-covered broker holding the account plus a few months of a real-money track record from other users, with a set price.
